name: sonarsniffer-desktop
description: SonarSniffer - Cross-platform desktop application for sonar data processing and analysis

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run tauri -- build
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:ui && npm run tauri -- build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:msi: npm run build:ui && npm run tauri -- build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -- --msi
